items.headline: 2 Brokerage Stocks to Buy Before Their October Earnings Reports
items.summary: Shares of Interactive Brokers (IBKR +2.90%) trade near $88 as of this writing, about 11% off their 52-week high of $98.75. And Charles Schwab (SCHW -1.70%) stock is near $97, about 15% under its 52-week high.
